title: REFURBISHING OF CLASSROOMS OF MARINE NAVIGATION TRAINING INSTITUTE, KOLKATA
summary: GeM BoQ bid for refurbishing classrooms at the Marine Navigation Training Institute, Deep Bhavan, Kolkata: study desks and chairs, carpet tiles, wall panelling, podiums, display units and modification of wooden daises.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, D-372/2, Taratala Road, Kolkata

sites.name: Marine Navigation Training Institute, Deep Bhavan, Kolkata
sites.work: Refurbishing of classrooms (furniture, carpet tiles, wall panelling, podium, display units)

scope.item: Supply of ready made main study desk 900x600x750 mm, Godrej Mayfair or similar
Supply of Thrill mesh full black chair, Godrej or similar
Modifying the existing wooden dias and refixing
Fixing of 8 mm high traffic heavy nylon commercial grade modular carpet tiles with specialized backing
Supply of wooden podium, laminated plywood with beadings as per design
Making wall panel framework of 19 mm ply cut in 50x19 mm in 600 c/c frame with fixing of 9 mm ply Ecotec MR
Fixing 12x80 mm wooden skirting, polish finish
Fixing 25x25 mm approx wooden beading with polish finish
Modification of the existing wooden dias and refixing
Fixing of 8 mm high traffic heavy nylon commercial grade modular carpet tiles with specialized backing (second item)
Making wall panel 4800x600x150 mm for display unit of 16 mm marine board, both sides laminated, aluminium edge step bending
Making wooden dias 5844x600x150 mm for display unit of 16 mm marine board, both sides laminated, aluminium edge step bending

money.notes: MII purchase preference L1+20% (50% qty); MSE purchase preference L1+15% (25% qty). Option clause +/-25% quantity.

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 7.28 lakh
3 years past experience for same/similar service; past performance 80% of bid quantity
No MSE or startup relaxation for experience and turnover
Only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers (MII); minimum local content 50%/20%
Additional documents requested in buyer ATC (ATC file not included)
specs: Study desk 900x600x750 mm (Godrej Mayfair or similar); mesh chair (Godrej or similar)
8 mm heavy nylon commercial grade modular carpet tiles
9 mm Ecotec MR ply wall panelling on 19 mm ply framework; 16 mm marine board display units with aluminium edging
